tagline: Single-Origin Micro Roastery & Seasonal Brunch Kitchen
story: Founded in 2021, Aura was born from a passion for transparent sourcing, ethical farming relationships, and culinary craftsmanship. Every bean is roasted in-house in small batches, highlighting terroir and delicate floral notes.
